/**
 * The settings of a Scene. Its body is the Scene's bounds, which edge Events use instead of the edges of the screen,
 * and which it fills with the background color, behind every other Actor. When the Scene starts, the camera moves
 * to [cameraStart], and its [music] plays, if it has some and the game plays audio.
 */
class SceneSettings private constructor(state: State) : Visible, Unique, Editable<SceneSettings> {
    override val body = state.body
    override val drawingOrder = Float.MAX_VALUE

    @set:Exposed(name = "backgroundColor")
    var backgroundColor: Color = state.backgroundColor

    @set:Exposed(name = "cameraStart")
    var cameraStart: SceneOffset = state.cameraStart

    /**
     * The music file, by its path from `composeResources` (like `files/music/theme.mp3`), or empty for none.
     */
    @set:Exposed(name = "music")
    var music: String = state.music

    private lateinit var generatedScenes: GeneratedScenes

    /**
     * The top left corner of the Scene's bounds.
     */
    val topLeft get() = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox.min

    /**
     * The bottom right corner of the Scene's bounds.
     */
    val bottomRight get() = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox.max

    override fun onAdded(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        generatedScenes = kubriko.get()
        generatedScenes.settings = this
        if (!generatedScenes.isInSceneEditor) kubriko.get<ViewportManager>().setCameraPosition(cameraStart)
    }

    override fun onRemoved() {
        if (generatedScenes.settings === this) generatedScenes.settings = null
    }

    override fun DrawScope.draw() = drawRect(
        color = backgroundColor,
        size = body.size.raw,
    )

    override fun save() = State(
        body = body,
        backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
        cameraStart = cameraStart,
        music = music,
    )

    @kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
    data class State(
        @SerialName("body") val body: SerializableBoxBody = BoxBody(),
        @SerialName("backgroundColor") val backgroundColor: SerializableColor = Color(0xFF202124),
        @SerialName("cameraStart") val cameraStart: SerializableSceneOffset = SceneOffset.Zero,
        @SerialName("music") val music: String = "",
    ) : Serializable.State<SceneSettings> {

        override fun restore() = SceneSettings(this)

        override fun serialize() = Json.encodeToString(this)
    }

    companion object {
        val metadata = EditableMetadata.create<SceneSettings, State>(typeId = "SceneSettings") { position ->
            State(body = BoxBody(initialPosition = position, initialSize = SceneSize(1280f.sceneUnit, 720f.sceneUnit)))
        }
    }
}
